title: Google\Cloud\Kms\V1\ExternalProtectionLevelOptions
name: ExternalProtectionLevelOptions
description: ExternalProtectionLevelOptions stores a group of additional fields for configuring a [CryptoKeyVersion][google.cloud.kms.v1.CryptoKeyVersion] that are specific to the [EXTERNAL][google.cloud.kms.v1.ProtectionLevel.EXTERNAL] protection level.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.external_key_uri
params.description: The URI for an external resource that this [CryptoKeyVersion][google.cloud.kms.v1.CryptoKeyVersion] represents.
